title: candidate.card_updated payload
description: Payload of the candidate.card_updated event (candidate-service; docs/data_model.md §12, docs/architecture.md §6.2). Carries only the agreed search-projection fields and MUST NOT contain PII (no email, phone or full_name).

candidate_id.description: Identifier of the candidate (candidate.profiles.id, logical reference).

visible_to_employers.description: Owner visibility flag from privacy_settings; false hides the public card.

display_name.description: Masked display name (first name + last-name initial); null when unset.

headline.description: Short professional headline; null when unset.

industry_code.description: Industry taxonomy code; null when unset.

specialization_code.description: Specialization taxonomy code; null when unset.

grade.description: Assigned category grade; null until assessment assigns one.

stack.description: Technology stack tokens; entries may be null for unset values.

fsp_verified.description: Whether achievements are verified via ФСП.

contact_released.description: Whether contacts are currently released to the employer.
